headline: GAAP loss as rates rise, but earnings still cover dividend

kpis.label: Earnings available for distribution per share

summary_short: Annaly's Q3 2026 GAAP loss was $(1.36) per share while earnings available for distribution were $0.80, above the $0.75 dividend; book value was $17.86 and economic return was -7.6%.
summary_long: Annaly says earnings exceeded the dividend despite a challenging interest rate environment. Economic leverage rose to 5.9x from 5.6x, with $4.2B of cash and unencumbered Agency MBS and $8.5B of assets available for financing. The company raised $757M of common equity through at-the-market sales and announced redemption of its $442.5M Series I preferred. The total portfolio was $106.5B, including $91.8B in Agency MBS.
confidence_notes: Source is the Q3 investor presentation furnished with the earnings release; prior-period comparisons for most metrics were not extracted. Earnings available for distribution is a non-GAAP measure. Shard EPS may reflect a different basis than the GAAP loss of $(1.36).

drivers.explanation: Leverage rose to 5.9x from 5.6x at the end of Q2; the company still describes its leverage profile as low.

drivers.metric: Earnings available for distribution per share
drivers.explanation: Average economic cost of interest-bearing liabilities rose 7 basis points q/q to 4.03%.
